description: This file defines various functions for handling authentication API interactions including registration, login, token extraction, token normalization, token refreshing, and logout. It also manages token storage locally and supports multiple response formats from the backend.

methods.name: extractTokens
methods.description: Extracts access and refresh tokens from various possible backend response formats.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes token strings, removing 'Bearer' prefix and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: registerApplicant
methods.description: Registers a new applicant by sending a POST request with email and password.

methods.name: loginStep1
methods.description: Performs login validation, clears existing tokens, and stores new tokens if provided.

methods.name: refreshTokens
methods.description: Requests new tokens using a refresh token and updates stored tokens.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by revoking the refresh token on the backend.
